reservations_release_reason_check.name: reservations_release_reason_check
reservations_release_reason_check.value:
("inventory"."reservations"."status" = 'released') = ("inventory"."reservations"."release_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("inventory"."reservations"."release_reason" IS NULL OR release_reason IN ('checkout_cancelled', 'order_cancelled', 'refunded', 'staff_correction'))

reservations_expires_at_check.name: reservations_expires_at_check
reservations_expires_at_check.value: ("inventory"."reservations"."kind" = 'hold' AND "inventory"."reservations"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("inventory"."reservations"."kind" = 'order' AND "inventory"."reservations"."expires_at" IS NULL)

refunds_note_check.name: refunds_note_check
refunds_note_check.value: "orders"."refunds"."note" IS NULL OR char_length("orders"."refunds"."note") BETWEEN 1 AND 500

dsr_requests_extension_check.name: dsr_requests_extension_check
dsr_requests_extension_check.value: ("privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extended_at" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_months" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_reason" IS NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_notice_at" IS NULL) OR ("privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_months" IN (1, 2) AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."extension_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "privacy"."dsr_requests"."due_at" > "privacy"."dsr_requests"."original_due_at")
